items.caseName: Ramkrushna Prahllad Dongardive v. State of Maharashtra
items.coram: Ujjal Bhuyan, Atul S. Chandurkar, JJ.
items.headline: No entrustment proved: cashier's acquittal restored
items.text: Bombay HC wrongly reversed acquittal under S.409 IPC and shifted the burden onto the accused; trial court acquittal restored.

pages.title: Orders
pages.note: No Supreme Court interim order, stay or notice passed in this window was reported by the legal publications we track.

items.caseName: Nandlal Rai alias Babloo Rai v. State of U.P.
items.headline: Murder conviction stayed so convict can contest polls
items.text: Conviction and sentence stayed pending appeal, citing his wish to contest the 2027 UP election; bail granted.

items.caseName: Arvind Pandey & Anr. v. State of U.P. & Ors.
items.headline: Workload no excuse for rubber-stamp remands
items.text: Accused freed on habeas corpus over a defective arrest memo; JTRI told to prepare remand training for Magistrates.

items.coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, CJ, Advait Sethna, J.
items.headline: State must answer plea on anti-CEC protest detentions
items.text: State's reply sought on pleas alleging illegal Mumbai Police detentions on 10–11 Oct; AG to file an affidavit via a senior officer.

items.caseName: Anu Aravind P. v. Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
items.headline: Disability percentage alone doesn't earn a quota
items.text: RPwD reservation needs a specified disability; court can't force the Centre to add MRKH Syndrome to the Schedule.

items.caseName: Gurpartap Singh v. National Investigation Agency
items.headline: No bail for alleged narco-terror financier
items.text: Prima facie material of funding BKI-linked activity; UAPA and NDPS bars apply, and long custody or parity didn't help.

items.caseName: Hemento Singh @ Hemant Singh v. State of Jharkhand
items.coram: Ananda Sen, Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, JJ.
items.headline: Gang rape conviction upheld despite FIR delay
items.text: Three-day delay was explained and no sperm after 72 hours is natural; injuries backed the victim, 20-year terms upheld.

items.caseName: M. Prasanna Kumar v. State of Karnataka & Ors.
items.headline: Practising without clearing AIBE can invite prosecution
items.text: Quashing plea dismissed; State Bar Council told to build a system flagging advocates who don't clear AIBE in two years.

items.caseName: B.R. Ramakrishna v. Union of India
items.headline: Building curbs near monuments are valid
items.text: Ss. 20A–20C AMASR Act upheld as regulation, not taking, so no compensation; fresh survey of the 59 m zone ordered.

items.headline: Daughter of void marriage inherits father's share
items.text: Following a 2023 SC ruling, her one-fourth share from the father's notional half in ancestral property was upheld.

items.caseName: Remadevi T.L. v. Reserve Bank of India & Ors.
items.headline: SBI must refund ₹3.73 lakh to fraud victim
items.text: She reported promptly and the bank didn't prove her negligence, so RBI's zero-liability rule applied.

items.caseName: Ravi E. & Anr. v. State of Kerala & Ors.
items.headline: No extension of SC deadline for temple elephants
items.text: Neither the State nor the HC can extend the 2015 Supreme Court deadline to register captive elephants.

items.caseName: Suo Motu v. State of Kerala & Ors.
items.coram: Soumen Sen, CJ, Syam Kumar V.M., J.
items.headline: Clear ₹9.73 crore victim compensation in five weeks
items.text: State told to release funds for 225 pending claims and KeLSA to speed payouts; listed on 2 December.

items.caseName: Aarush Shanmugam Gurudev v. Regional Passport Officer
items.headline: Child keeps citizenship after father goes British
items.text: A minor Indian by birth doesn't lose citizenship because his father later took UK citizenship; passport to be decided in 3 months.

items.headline: CJP activists' custody extended by two days
items.text: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka kept in custody as sureties were rejected as unfit; fresh sureties sought, listed 21 Oct.
